text:
Maria L: Quick sync 1 opened a PR to add a compact reproducibility snippet and a short guidance box showing batching + q4_0 vs q4_K tradeoffs for short sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/389

Devin P: Nice. The snippet currently uses the old client factory signature; we'll need to migrate to newClient({ requestOptions }).

Maria L: Thanks 1 I can update the code but want to wait until bench numbers are in so the callout p50/p95 match the infra results. Can someone run a small T4/A10 microbench?

Kyle R: I can run quick runs tonight. Plan: run batch sizes [1,4,16] for seq lenses [16,64], record p50/p95, and throw in a short flamegraph. I'll post a sanitized CSV and commands. Found one broken anchor in the migration guide too, will open a tiny PR to fix that.

Sasha M: Quick doc suggestion: add a two-line "how to read this" before the table that explains why small batches can improve latency when KV prefetch hit rates are high. Also include the aggregate-window default we recommend (50ms) and say when to lower it for <32 token requests.

Maria L: Proposed blurb: "Short, latency-sensitive requests (<=32 tokens): set max_batch to 1-4 and agg_window 10-50ms; prefer q4_0 for lowest latency. For throughput, increase batch size and q4_K for denser memory use." Can we cite numbers?

Kyle R: Will post numbers. If they look noisy I'll run more trials and include command flags.

Devin P: After Kyle posts, I'll update the JS snippet to newClient(...) and tidy formatting. Also suggest adding a tiny reproducibility shell snippet (curl + loop) so readers can run locally against hosted API keys.


docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs require >=1 eng + 1 docs reviewer. Label: needs-eng-review.

Maria L: Action items: (1) Kyle: bench logs + link-fix PR, (2) Sasha: draft the "how to read" paragraph and default knobs, (3) Devin: patch SDK snippet after benches. I'll rebase after these land and request final review. Thanks all :rocket:
